why: Confirm must be the bottom face button (A/Cross), the same index the gameplay reader calls fire; on another index a pad's A does nothing in menus. KILLED-BY RETITLED: that test used to assert menu confirm/back were the SAME buttons as fire/mine. Fire and mine moved to the triggers so a twin-stick player need not leave the aim stick, so the assertion inverted to disjointness and the name moved with it. The index moved to STANDARD_PROFILE under issue #596; gamepad-menu.ts's MENU_CONFIRM_BUTTON is derived from it, so mutating the profile is what mutating the constant used to be.
killedBy: createGamepadMenuPoller: button indices confirm and back are DISJOINT from fire and mine, so a menu press cannot leak a shot, and pause is Start (9)
